# Dataset contract

**Source:** Original synthetic fixtures generated by `generate_data.py`. No third-party data or real people are included.

**Seed:** 202702. Included data is CC0-1.0 under the root DATA_LICENSE.md. All dates refer to fictional 2025 records.

## Grain and field meaning

One row per observed order version. order_id identifies an order; version controls deterministic last-version selection; amount_cents is integer USD cents and order_date is the partition key.

## Fixture inventory

### `transactions.csv`
327 records.

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | int64 | `1` |
| `version` | int64 | `1` |
| `order_date` | object | `2025-01-02` |
| `amount_cents` | int64 | `17389` |

## Intentional edge cases

Compare raw and bronze SHA-256, assert latest-version selection, reconcile gold totals and verify two independent transformations are identical.

## Regeneration

`python generate_data.py` recreates the fixture files. It does not rerun the pipeline. The generator source is the authoritative construction recipe.

## Validation boundary

This implementation uses local CSV layers, not Delta Lake transactions, Spark or Databricks. Whole-directory publication and concurrent-writer control are outside scope.
